emails.body:
YOU’RE INVITED

Some developers think about software as a craft.

They obsess over every pixel. They lose sleep over an abstraction that doesn't feel right. These builders are everywhere, but they rarely get a chance to be in the same room. We're changing that.

Join us at our first conference, Resend Forward.

October 21st in San Francisco

Get your ticket for 20% off https://forward.resend.com/register/discount/BUILD-IN-PUBLIC

















A DAY DEDICATED TO CRAFTING
HIGH-QUALITY SOFTWARE

Resend Forward is a day for builders to gather, connect, and share ideas.

We'll hear from Guillermo Rauch on how AI agents are changing DX at Vercel, Dave Kiss on whether coding is dead, Valentina Bearzotti on how to develop taste, and many more https://resend.com/forward/agenda.


GUILLERMO RAUCH

CEO
Vercel


CRISTINA CORDOVA

Chief Operating Officer
Linear







KATH KOREVEC

Member of Product Staff
OpenAI




DAVE KISS

Staff Community Engineer
Mux








EVERY DETAIL MATTERS

Resend Forward is built by a team who sweats every detail. In less than 40 days, a vibrant community of builders who care will gather together under one roof.

We hope you'll join us.



We'll meet in the SFJAZZ Center, the first stand-alone structure in the U.S. built specifically for jazz performance.






SFJAZZ Center, San Francisco





WILL WE SEE YOU THERE?

Join us for a full day of talks, thought-provoking conversations
with other builders, premium swag, and great food.

Get tickets at 20% off https://forward.resend.com/register/discount/BUILD-IN-PUBLIC


Tickets go up in price September 18.

Resend · 2261 Market St #5039, San Francisco, CA, 94114

emails.subject: Bigger free tier, metrics API, and MCP spec support
emails.snippet: Hey, it's Zeno. This month, we gave every account 3 free domains on the free tier https://resend.com/changelog/three-domains-on-the-free-tier, we've added custom suppression lists
emails.body:
Hey, it's Zeno.

This month, we gave every account 3 free domains on the free tier https://resend.com/changelog/three-domains-on-the-free-tier, we've added custom suppression lists https://resend.com/changelog/suppression-list-support, support for agent plugins https://resend.com/changelog/agent-plugins-standard and the new MCP spec https://resend.com/changelog/resend-mcp-supports-the-new-2026-07-28-spec.

We also dropped an entire headless analytics API https://resend.com/changelog/email-metrics-api that's extensible so we can continue to add additional metrics to fit your needs.

And don't forget our first-ever conference, Resend Forward https://resend.com/forward, is quickly approaching.

Quick question:

> What feature should we put on our roadmap?

Just hit reply. We read every answer.





3 DOMAINS FOR ALL

https://resend.com/changelog/three-domains-on-the-free-tier

The free tier now includes 3 verified domains, so you can build and send from more projects without upgrading. Every free team can now verify up to three domains, in any region, at no cost.

→ Read the changelog https://resend.com/changelog/three-domains-on-the-free-tier





HEADLESS EMAIL ANALYTICS

https://resend.com/changelog/email-metrics-api

Get data about your emails, from the send volume to unsubscribe rate, grouped or filtered by the period, domain, broadcast, or email.

→ Try the new Metrics API https://resend.com/changelog/email-metrics-api





A NEW WAY TO VERIFY YOUR EMAIL

https://resend.com/blog/email-verification-api

A new proposal aims to enable email verification directly within the browser. We covered all the details, and built a library for you to try it out.

→ Read the blog post https://resend.com/blog/email-verification-api





RESEND NOW SUPPORTS AGENT PLUGINS

https://resend.com/changelog/agent-plugins-standard

Resend Skills added support for the Agent Plugins Standard, an open, vendor-neutral standard for packaging skills and MCP servers into a portable plugin.

→ Check the guide https://resend.com/changelog/agent-plugins-standard





MANAGE YOUR OWN SUPPRESSIONS

https://resend.com/changelog/suppression-list-support

Spam complaints and hard bounces can wreck your sending reputation, which is why Resend has always suppressed those addresses behind the scenes. Now you can see, manage, and automate your suppression list yourself. Here's how the new tools work.

→ Learn more about Suppressions https://resend.com/changelog/suppression-list-support





RESEND SUPPORTS THE NEW MCP SPEC

https://resend.com/changelog/resend-mcp-supports-the-new-2026-07-28-spec

The MCP specification just released a major upgrade, and now Resend's remote MCP server supports this latest version.

→ Read the changelog https://resend.com/changelog/resend-mcp-supports-the-new-2026-07-28-spec





A FULL VIDEO TOUR


https://youtu.be/FzoakVwRm2Q

Take a full tour of Resend, the email API built for developers. In under 8 minutes, see how to authenticate your domain, send transactional and marketing emails, build automations, and debug with full observability, all from the dashboard, API, SDKs, CLI, or MCP.

→ Watch the video http://youtube.com/watch?v=FzoakVwRm2Q





FOR BUILDERS WHO CARE

https://forward.resend.com/register/discount/RESEND-USER

It's easier than ever to make software, fast. Today, true artisans are differentiated on their attention to detail.

We're hosting a conference to gather builders who still care about their craft. Those who:

 * Lose sleep over an abstraction

 * Tweak designs pixel-by-pixel

 * Spend time fixing things most will never notice

Resend Forward takes place October 21, 2026 in San Francisco.

Since you're a user, we've set aside a reduced rate for you.

→ Attend Forward https://forward.resend.com/register/discount/RESEND-USER




Happy sending,
Zeno Rocha
